title: Among cards illustrated by artists who have also created Japanese-translate
question: Among cards illustrated by artists who have also created Japanese-translated cards, find the most common visual frame effect for those that are both incredibly powerful foils and have unknown or infinite power (i.e., power is NULL, '*', or '∞').

prediction.sql:
SELECT c.XCL_018
FROM cards c
WHERE c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards c2
    WHERE c2.XCL_072 IN (
        SELECT fd.XCL_082
        FROM foreign_data fd
        WHERE fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese'
    )
)
AND c.XCL_006 IS NOT NULL
AND (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*' OR c.XCL_055 = '∞')
GROUP BY c.XCL_018
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.XCL_018
FROM cards c
WHERE c.XCL_002 IN (
    SELECT c2.XCL_002
    FROM cards c2
    WHERE c2.XCL_072 IN (
        SELECT fd.XCL_082
        FROM foreign_data fd
        WHERE fd.XCL_077 = 'Japanese'
    )
)
AND c.XCL_006 IS NOT NULL
AND (c.XCL_055 IS NULL OR c.XCL_055 = '*' OR c.XCL_055 = '∞')
GROUP BY c.XCL_018
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1
